topline: No uploads, no storage, no install
dl_title: Paste a link. Get the original file.
dl_lede: No re-encoding, no transcoding — only the qualities this video actually has.
pv_empty: Video info and available qualities will appear here after parsing
platforms_none: No platform is enabled right now
tr_title: Same Wi-Fi, straight to the other device.
tr_lede: Files travel device-to-device. They never touch our server, are never compressed or converted, and are verified with SHA-256.
tr_drop: Drop files here (you can drop a whole folder on desktop)
tr_code_label: Give this code to the other device
tr_waiting: Waiting for the other device… (share this code)
tr_broken: Connection lost. Make sure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi and keep the page open.
tr_expired: Pairing expired — create a new code
tr_sent: All sent — waiting for the other side to verify…
tr_acked_ok: The other device confirmed the file is intact (hash matches)
tr_acked_bad: The other device reported a hash mismatch
teach_faq: iPhone transfers stop on large files
A browser memory limit. Use a computer for files over 1 GB, or send them in batches.
Office or school Wi-Fi won't connect
That network uses AP isolation, so the two devices can't see each other. Turn on one phone's hotspot and connect both devices to it.
Download them to the device first (Photos will show them as downloaded), then select them here.
We list exactly what the platform offers — up to 8K. If a video only has one quality, that's the only option.
No. Downloads come straight from the platform's CDN, and transfers go directly between your devices. We never touch your files.
plans_lede: No account needed. Your free quota resets at 00:00 in your own time zone; download and transfer are counted separately.
pay_preparing: Payments aren't live yet — the checkout flow is ready and goes live once the payment gateway is connected.
pay_ready: Payment gateway connected. You can start charging.
member_lede: Sign in to keep your quota across devices; paid plans get unlimited downloads and transfers.
history_note: Only the videos you downloaded, stored on your own device.
maintenance: Under maintenance. Please try again later.
teach_dl_steps: In the app tap Share → Copy link
Come back here, paste it in the box and press Parse
Pick the quality and press “Download to this device”
teach_dl_note: Parsing is free; one download uses one free quota.
teach_tr_steps: Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi
One device presses “Create my code”; the other enters the 6 digits and presses Pair
Wait until the status says Connected
Pick files → Start sending (paired devices are remembered)
teach_os_list: iOS / Android / HarmonyOS / Windows / macOS / Linux
Safari / Chrome / Edge / Firefox (in-app browsers in WeChat, QQ, LINE may not work)
